messages:
Emma Chen: quick heads-up — during the vuln triage I found two runtime base images with processes running as root and CAP_NET_ADMIN still granted.
Raj Patel: ugh. which image tags?
Emma Chen: redwood/runtime:2025-03-12 and redwood/edge-proxy:1.4.2 (old build). saw it in prod canary logs and local repro.
Olivia Gomez: can we do a targeted rebuild that enforces non-root user, drops capabilities, and adds seccomp? propose canary in staging first.
Mike Torres: +1. we also need to stop using static signing keys in k8s secrets — move to KMS-backed cosign signing. current process gives builder write access to the key.
Emma Chen: also noticed we aren't forwarding image pull/audit logs consistently to Datadog for some clusters — that'll make triage harder.
Raj Patel: proposed plan: 1) create minimal base image with USER 1000, drop CAP_NET_ADMIN/NET_BIND_SERVICE/etc, add runtime-default seccomp; 2) sign images via KMS-backed cosign; 3) enforce via admission controller (require signature + non-root); 4) canary to 2 staging clusters; 5) prod cutover window and rollback plan.
Olivia Gomez: timeline constraint: avoid the customer deploy window Wed 22:00 UTC. prefer early-morning canary.
Mike Torres: I can take KMS + IAM changes. will create restricted IAM role 'image-signer' (sign-only) and remove signing access from builders. Also rotate the current key and re-sign the canary images.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary-request accepted (requested by Mike Torres). scheduled tentative canary for 1749130000. ticket IM-8821 created.
devops-ci: cosign KMS example for the runbook: 
```
COSIGN_KMS=awskms://arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef12-3456
cosign sign --key $COSIGN_KMS gcr.io/redwood/runtime:2025-03-12
```
Olivia Gomez: admission controller policy draft: require cosign signature from image-signer KMS key AND container.process.user >= 1000 AND seccomp profile 'runtime-default'. also deny NET_ADMIN capability.
Emma Chen: for audit: add Fluentd->Datadog forwarder for image_pull / gcr access logs and runtime audit events, retention 90d, and create a Datadog log alert for unsigned-image pulls.
Raj Patel: RBAC changes summary: - revoke builder role on KMS key, create image-builder (push-only) and image-signer (sign-only). Who will own the k8s role binding and IAM changes?
Mike Torres: I'll own IAM PRs. tagging @Olivia for security review.
Olivia Gomez: lgtm, please include an approval/review step in PR and add an automated test that tries to push unsigned image and ensure admission blocks it. :thumbsup:
Emma Chen: scheduling: staging canary tomorrow 08:00 UTC, production cutover Thu 02:00 UTC if canary passes. emergency rollback: keep previous signed image tags available and admission controller should allow the pre-approved fallback signature.
Raj Patel: add audit tag 'image_rebuild_run:2025-03-13' to all related logs to simplify post-mortem correlation.
Olivia Gomez: also update the incident runbook: include steps to revoke KMS key + rotate cosign key if we suspect compromise.
Mike Torres: added runbook note in ticket IM-8821 and started the IAM PR. I'll post the PR link when ready.
Emma Chen: thanks — I'll start the actual base-image rebuild and open a short PR with diff (USER change + seccomp + capability drops). ping me if any blockers. :rocket:
